name: Dashy (Legacy)
description: Dashy helps you organize your self-hosted services by making them accessible from a single place

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the dashy application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-dashy
  big-bear-dashy:
    # Image to be used for the app service
    image: lissy93/dashy:3.3.1@sha256:8c04ab116bb52bd784137d3922acaa945b5559de49a14f163dbbcf0605adf3e6
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-dashy
    # Uncomment below if you want to mount volumes
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/public:/app/public
    # Ports mapping
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
    # Set any environmental variables
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
    # Restart policy for the container
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Configure healthchecks for the service
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "/app/services/healthcheck"]
      interval: 1m30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
